title: pyrus cornifolia
intro: Pyrus cornifolia, commonly known as Chinese mountain apple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus cornifolia include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting sweating to help with fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
